script.speaker: liam
script.text: it is SO hot. i'm melting and i'm hungry, which are my two least favourite things at once

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: last hot night of the summer, apparently! crew, we're doing something by the water tonight

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: i'm down. already by the water, the breeze is the only thing keeping me alive

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Seven works for me. Maya, you've been typing for ten minutes.

script.speaker: maya
script.text: sorry!! i had to check something three times before i said it out loud

script.speaker: maya
script.text: remember that plan i pitched? it got me promoted. with a raise. did the math, trip is funded.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: MAYA!! so the sky's the limit tonight??

script.speaker: maya
script.text: funded, not rich. my sky is two dollar signs now. a three-sign place and i'll still come, but i'll sigh at the bill so loudly the gulls fly off

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: a pat on the back AND a paycheck!! ok, this is officially a celebration. by the water. ideas?

script.speaker: liam
script.text: a kid dropped his whole scoop off his cone outside my building today. i watched it melt into the pavement and i've wanted one of my own ever since

script.speaker: liam
script.text: that kid had the right idea though, sitting out in the sea air with it. last hot night of summer, we should enjoy the breeze while we still can

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: celebration scoops!! i'm getting a giant one with every topping they've got

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: 'Every topping' is how my worst evenings start. The crushed peanuts always sit right next to the sprinkles, and the same spoon visits both. Same if the scoop goes from the peanut butter tub straight into yours.

script.speaker: maya
script.text: nobody is reliving the satay incident on my funded night. absolutely not

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: speaking of toppings. my neighbour's housewarming yesterday ended with fried dough, three sauces and a mountain of whipped cream

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: i can still feel it. tonight i want something that tastes mostly of fruit, not a dessert stacked on top of a dessert

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: don't worry about me btw, i've got a system. i always order the sherbet. it's the safe one

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: wait. just checked the tub in my freezer. sherbet has MILK in it??

script.speaker: maya
script.text: tiny milkshake incidents all summer and you called it weather. nothing milky for you tonight, whatever the board calls it

script.speaker: liam
script.text: assistant, the sun's dropping and i still can't stop thinking about that kid's cone. help
